evd_title: GPT-4 cost approximately 100x more than Mixtral-8x22B per 100 papers in evidence appraisal
finding: GPT-4 cost approximately 100x more than Mixtral-8x22B per 100 papers in evidence appraisal
P: 112 SRs/MAs in pediatric surgery (Cullis et al.) for PRISMA/AMSTAR; 56 RCTs from PragMeta for PRECIS-2
I: Claude-3-Opus (PNG pages), Claude-2, GPT-4-32k-0613, GPT-3.5-turbo-16k-0613, Mixtral-8x22B; extract-quote-rate prompt, temp 0; API cost logged
O: Median cost per 100 papers: GPT-4 $115.00 vs Mixtral-8x22B $1.20 (~96x); Claude-3-Opus $40, Claude-2 $19, GPT-3.5 $6
